summary: Decodes SMPTE linear timecode from an audio CHOP signal into timecode-related channels.
key_concepts: Reads SMPTE linear timecode encoded into an audio signal, usually after the signal has been brought into CHOPs through Audio Device In CHOP.
Input Frame Rate is the number of complete LTC frame messages per second and is usually between 24 and 30.
Discrete Channels, Total LTC Frames, Total Seconds, and User Fields opt into frame/time/user-bit output channels.
Up-sample to Timeline FPS resamples decoded timecode to project FPS and changes the meaning of total elapsed LTC frames.
Debug Channels expose quantized signal, decoded bits, consecutive one-bit count, and successful decode count for troubleshooting.

key_params.name: inputrate
key_params.note: Encoded LTC frame rate, usually 24 to 30

key_params.name: upsample
key_params.note: Resample decoded timecode to project FPS

common_gotchas: LTC In CHOP expects an audio signal already brought into CHOPs, typically through Audio Device In CHOP.
Input Frame Rate must match the encoded LTC frame message rate, usually 24 to 30 fps.
Total LTC Frames changes when up-sampling to the timeline FPS, so do not treat it as raw decoded frame count in that mode.
Debug bits are decoded from specific edge sequences, not raw on/off levels.
Use the broader Timecode tools/workflow when synchronizing a full project rather than only reading channels.
